limitations_and_boundaries: Only four datasets used, all from cancer cell lines.
Datasets chosen because they were used in the publications presenting GEARS, scGPT, and scFoundation.
Cancer cell lines may have high mutational burden; Geneformer excluded such data.
No attempt to improve original quality control (e.g., excluding perturbations that did not affect target gene expression).
Benchmark limited to specific models and versions; results may not generalize to other tasks or future models.

methods.name: No change baseline
methods.protocol_description: Predicts the same expression as in the control condition for each double perturbation.

methods.name: Additive baseline
methods.protocol_description: For each double perturbation, predicts the sum of the individual logarithmic fold changes (LFCs) from single perturbations.

methods.name: Mean baseline
methods.protocol_description: Predicts the overall average expression across perturbations in the training set.

methods.name: Linear model (equation 1)
methods.protocol_description: Represents read-out genes with K-dimensional vectors (G) and perturbations with L-dimensional vectors (P). G and P from PCA on training data or external embeddings. Solves argmin_W ||Ytrain - (G W P^T + b)||^2_2 with ridge penalty λ=0.1. b is row means of Ytrain.
